parent_objective: audit gate-margin response-amplification exact gate pass

public_gates: normal retention and wrong gap are quantified
next step is selected without overclaiming deployment
forbidden_shortcuts: do not promote residual head as a driver checkpoint
do not admit PPO without a design milestone
do not hide gate diagnostic caveat
do not change actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_action: recurrent capability signal to actuator-level correction
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits whether the M689 exact diagnostic pass justifies closed-loop replay or actor-update continuation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic residual-head exact-gate pass, not promoted driver behavior
stop_condition: stop this branch if the M690 audit cannot define a closed-loop replay or actor-update admission path without weakening exact gates
stop before PPO or promotion unless a new manifest explicitly adds proof, behavior, and generalization gates
stop after at most 10 additional response-amplification milestones without a synthesis artifact
fallback_plan: if gate diagnostics remain ambiguous, run a synthesis milestone that compares residual-head output separation against true closed-loop replay needs
if closed-loop replay fails despite M689 exact pass, audit whether the residual target is open-loop diagnostic only and return to source-diverse terminal-boundary target mining
if actor-update admission fails, design a smaller projection or adapter-only branch rather than extending PPO
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: after M690 audit and before any post-M689 closed-loop or actor-update continuation

hypothesis: M689 is a valid exact-gated positive diagnostic result, but gate diagnostics show it should be audited before any closed-loop or actor-update branch.
success_criteria: audit distinguishes diagnostic residual-head pass from driver promotion
failure_criteria: audit overclaims M689 as a deployable driver result
audit ignores normal gate not closing
audit admits PPO without a design milestone

commands.name: write_audit
commands.command: write docs/m690-gate-margin-response-amplification-audit.md from M689 artifacts; no training

decision_rule: M690 passes if it admits the M689 exact diagnostic result with caveats and selects a next design without promotion, PPO, or actor-input changes.
